summary: Phase 8 final UAT sweep — frontend only against public preview. Ran a targeted acceptance pass across security headers, PWA assets, nav redirects, rebuilt pages, responsive matrix and terminology sweep. Verified GREEN: (1) all Phase-8 API security headers present on /api responses (X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy, Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only, Permissions-Policy); (2) /sw.js and /manifest.webmanifest load 200 with correct content (versioned caches, /api never cached, network-first navigations with offline shell fallback, valid PWA manifest with name/icons); (3) retired-route redirects for buyer scope work — /demand→/buyer/home, /claims→/buyer/issues, /orders→/buyer/orders; (4) rebuilt pages render with expected data-testids — claims-page, account-page (with real KYB file input + kyb-submit-btn, no hardcoded document), catalog-page (human 'Demo — not for production buying' label present); (5) responsive matrix at 360/390/412/768/1440 for buyer home, buyer request wizard, buyer orders, buyer catalog — no horizontal body scroll; (6) buyer bottom nav renders at 390px with Home/Offers/Orders/Events/More; (7) no page/console errors on tested rebuilt pages; (8) buyer Issues page shows no raw enum tokens (PENDING_CONFIRMATION / COUNTERPARTY_RESPONSE / IN_REVIEW absent). Findings (all P2/P3): SW registration is gated on import.meta.env.PROD but the preview environment runs Vite dev mode (/@vite/client + /src/main.tsx present in the HTML) so navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration() returns null in the preview — SW code itself is correct, this only affects the preview environment. BottomNav container does not attach its `testId` prop to a DOM node (only inner items do), so `data-testid="buyer-bottomnav"` selector cannot find the container. Several other flows (supplier capabilities, ops/partner redirects while logged in with those roles, requirement workspace publish-RFQ, admin catalog version history, keyboard-only a11y pass, offline shell fallback, upload MIME/magic-byte rejection UI) could not be fully exercised in this session because Cloudflare's bot-challenge kicked in mid-run (429s + human-verification captcha) — this is a testing-environment constraint, not a product defect. Static code review of the rebuilt pages confirms the shape of each fix (real file input in AccountPage, no supplier-UUID input in RequirementDetailPage, product/variety selects in CapabilitiesPage).

ui_bugs.issue: SW registration is guarded by `if (import.meta.env.PROD && 'serviceWorker' in navigator)`. The preview URL is currently served by Vite dev (HTML shows `/@vite/client` and `/src/main.tsx?t=...`), so `import.meta.env.PROD` is false and the SW never registers on the preview. Consequence: navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration() returns null on the preview and the 'offline shell fallback' AC cannot be validated here. /sw.js itself is served 200 with the correct cache-first-static / network-first-navigation / never-cache-/api policy, and /manifest.webmanifest is valid. This is fine for production builds; flagging so main agent decides whether to also enable SW in preview builds or explicitly document the exception.

The `testId` prop passed to <BottomNav testId="buyer-bottomnav"/> (and supplier/partner/ops/admin equivalents) is only propagated to inner elements (`${i.testId}-bottom` for items, `${testId}-more` for the More button, `${testId}-more-drawer` for the drawer). The bottom-nav container itself has no `data-testid`, so `[data-testid="buyer-bottomnav"]` returns 0 matches even though the nav is visually present at 390px. Recommend adding `data-testid={testId}` to the <nav>/root element of BottomNav.

Buyer catalog renders products with the human label 'Demo — not for production buying' as expected, but the counterpart 'Validated' label was not visible in the seeded catalog. Likely a seed-data condition (no validated products in dev DB) rather than a code bug — noting so main agent can confirm the Validated code path is exercised in a fuller seed.

critical_code_review_comments: P3: apps/web/src/main.tsx wraps SW registration in `import.meta.env.PROD`. Preview is served in Vite dev mode, so the SW never registers there and the Phase-8 offline-shell AC cannot be validated on the preview URL. Consider either (a) documenting the preview-vs-prod gap explicitly, or (b) allowing SW registration when `import.meta.env.MODE !== 'test'` so preview builds can be verified.

P3: apps/web/src/shell/ShellNav.tsx `BottomNav` accepts a `testId` prop but never applies it to a root DOM node. Only items and the More affordance carry it. Add `data-testid={testId}` to the container to make the selectors used in Phase-8 mobile AC (`buyer-bottomnav`, `ops-bottomnav`, etc.) resolvable.

Carryover from iteration_20 (still recommended even though outside Phase-8 scope): apps/web/src/lib/api/client.ts still calls `await res.json()` on the success path — any 204 response will throw. Not re-tested this iteration but the fix from iteration_20 should be verified.

Positive: The SW policy in public/sw.js is correctly implemented — versioned cache names, activate cleanup, /api bypass, network-first navigations with `/index.html` shell fallback, cache-first ONLY for /assets|/icons|/brand. This is exactly what the Phase-8 ADR requires.

Positive: Security-headers middleware is correctly applied to all API responses — verified live via curl on /api/health. All required headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only, Permissions-Policy) present.

Positive: AccountPage KYB submission uses a real <input type=file> (no fake hardcoded document), and kyb-submit-btn testid is present. Static review confirms no supplier-UUID text input on RequirementDetailPage and product/variety <select> pickers on CapabilitiesPage.

rca_of_the_issue: PWA SW-not-registering-on-preview root cause: apps/web/src/main.tsx line 19 gates `navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js')` on `import.meta.env.PROD`. The preview URL is served by Vite dev (evidence: index.html contains `<script type="module" src="/@vite/client">` and `src="/src/main.tsx?t=..."`), so PROD is false and the register() call never runs. /sw.js and /manifest.webmanifest themselves are served correctly (curl 200, valid content). Fix (if desired for preview validation): change guard to `import.meta.env.MODE !== 'test'` OR set `mode: 'production'` for preview builds. Otherwise, the AC 'service worker registers in a fresh Chromium session' should be tested against a production build, not the preview.
